scope: Prepare exact current packed launcher as data-only CD, with original project-owned Windows runtime helpers. No execution or VM mutation in preparation.

candidate.source: stage87 public vendor update ZIP; stage88 pure candidate/Python comparison

target.win7: Preserve exact existing exe path and user-confirmed compatibility state; do not reopen/rewrite settings.

readiness: Mac normally unlocked and a fresh existing Windows window observed.
Demonstrate ordinary guest input and read exact pending readonly log-prefix hash line before cancel/submit; no blind relaunch.
Attach only validated new readonly ISO through native optical-drive controls after fresh target read; no network/shared-folder/security changes.
Verify helper/media hash on guest and parse with Windows PowerShell parser; if execution policy blocks script, stop and report, do not change/bypass it.
Verify exact old launcher/updater/twoXML hashes, current CD candidate and no matching launcher/updater process.

modes.effects: Read-only baseline/candidate/path/process checks; print controlled metadata. No target changes.

One unique owned backup directory; verified create-new backups of launcher/updater/twoXML and original attributes, staged current candidate, atomic replacement of only exact old EXE after clearing only its ReadOnly bit if needed. Preserve source originals/registry/mount policy. Failure preserves partial state and blocks blind reinstall.

Single recorded normal RunAs/UAC attempt of exact current runtime EXE, no arguments, working directory same; monitor returned process handle with monotonic90s deadline after Start-Process returns. Record submission/UAC-return/parent start/exit separately. No account input, window-title/argv/memory/network-payload capture, forced termination or credential operations. If still running, leave it and report live PID for normal UI handling; no child-lifecycle completeness claim.

After no matching process and exact whitelisted current/original hash, restore only the EXE this tool replaced and its original allowed attributes from verified backup. Other backed-up files are retained for review; no full VM/app-state rollback claim, no deletion/cleanup.

stops: Wrong path/hash/source/process/readiness; missing/changed receipts or any reparse path; existing partial stage folder; unexpected current EXE hash.
Windows execution-policy/security denial: do not bypass or alter settings.
New legal agreement, account/credential gate or unexpected permission: stop at the displayed gate. Existing Windows/network/tool permission is not re-requested.
At observation90s, report running parent/known-name process metadata and use fresh UI before any close; no blind keys/forcekill.

verification.host: Official portable PowerShell parser and original synthetic filesystem fixtures; validates syntax and helpers on macOS only.
verification.media: Read-back exact expected member set/bytes/hashes from ISO; no autorun/network execution.
verification.guest: Not yet run. Host7.6 parsing does not prove Windows5.1, UAC, NTFS atomicity, lifecycle or actual dependency correctness.
